Immediate supplemental irrigation will close the water gap while the existing agronomic practices can be maintained. Risks are low, and the opportunity to achieve a high yield is strong.
actions: Apply flood irrigation today to raise cumulative water input toward the 1000‑2000 mm target for the season.
Maintain the recommended balanced NPK fertilizer schedule (no change needed, nitrogen already optimal).
Monitor soil moisture daily using a handheld probe or moisture sensor; adjust irrigation frequency accordingly.
Conduct weekly visual scouting for blast, sheath blight, and leaf spot symptoms.
Obtain updated satellite NDVI imagery every 7 days (when cloud cover permits) to verify canopy health.
